text: Every day, your customers ask the same things on WhatsApp. Where's my order? Can I return this? And every answer comes from you, by hand.
Lane Desk is a managed WhatsApp support desk for Indian online stores.
Every message takes one of five routes. Order questions are answered straight from your store, only after the customer's number matches the order.
When AI drafts a reply, the reply guard checks it against your policy first. If it promises a discount you don't offer, it's held.
And when it's hard, a person takes over, with the full chat, so no one has to repeat themselves.
You don't set up a bot. Bot Lane connects your store, writes the policy wording with you, and reviews every week.
Start with a pilot, at six thousand, nine hundred and ninety-nine rupees a month.
Lane Desk. Fast answers, safe answers, and a human when it matters.
